title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Adjustment of Disputed Damage Repair Charges under Damage Protection
content:
On an agreement with damage protection, a damage repair charge named by a damage dispute whose status is approved is adjusted once, by the disputed charge less the excess the renter keeps, never more than the disputed charge, and a charge already adjusted is not adjusted again; the adjustment takes effect when the renter accepts it as the remedy for the dispute. This applies to Ridgeline Tool Rental agreements.

## Conditions

The adjustment on an approved damage dispute is fixed only after the agreement carries the damage deductible line owed for the incident.

No adjustment on an approved damage dispute is booked until the agreement carries the missing-accessory charge owed from the return inspection.

Before the adjustment on an approved damage dispute is worked out, the agreement must carry the refuelling charge owed for its fuel reading at return.

Restated in the same terms: the amount of the adjustment waits on the agreement showing the damage deductible line owed for the incident, the missing-accessory charge owed from the return inspection and the refuelling charge owed for its fuel reading at return.

## Capability

`accept_damage_adjustment_c3a91d5f` is the renter's acceptance of the adjustment offered on a disputed damage repair charge as the remedy for the damage dispute on one Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement. One call books a single charge adjustment line, dated today, tied to the disputed charge and to the renter's dispute, and lowers the amount the renter owes on the agreement by exactly the adjustment accepted.

## How it is invoked

This is the customer's own tool. The Customer Care agent unlocks `accept_damage_adjustment_c3a91d5f` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_agreement_id` | The rental agreement (one equipment item) the adjustment is booked on, as given to the renter by the Customer Care agent from the rental agreement lookup. | Id |
| `rental_request_id` | The renter's damage dispute the adjustment settles, as given to the renter by the Customer Care agent from the rental request lookup. | Id |
| `original_charge_id` | The disputed damage repair charge line being adjusted, as given to the renter by the Customer Care agent from the rental charge lookup. | Id |
| `adjustment_amount` | The adjustment accepted, in USD, exactly as the agent stated it. | Positive, 2 decimal places, no currency sign; stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places. |

## Return

`status` "adjusted" when the adjustment line was booked; `rental_charge_id` (the new adjustment line); `rental_agreement_id`; `original_charge_id` (the disputed charge adjusted); `rental_request_id` (the dispute it settles); `amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the agreement, USD with 2 decimal places, negative when the agreement is overpaid).
